title: Earth Index Imagery
description: Deprecated Earth Index yearly cloudless Sentinel-2 mosaics (calendar-year 2022-2025, partial 2018-2021, plus some quarterly and half-year windows) as Cloud-Optimized GeoTIFFs in Web Mercator, organized by UTM grid tile. Includes all Sentinel-2 L2A bands except B10 at native resolution, with quality and provenance metadata. Superseded by Earth Index Imagery V7.

## README.md
> [!WARNING]
> **Deprecated.** This product is no longer updated, but it is kept because it holds the **only copies of earlier imagery**: calendar-year mosaics for 2022, 2023, 2024 and 2025, partial coverage for 2018-2021, and some shorter (quarterly and half-year) windows from 2024-2025. None of these are in V7. The latest generation is **[Earth Index Imagery V7](https://source.coop/earthgenome/earthindeximagery-v7)** (`earthgenome/earthindeximagery-v7`), a global mosaic for the single window 2025-08-16 → 2026-08-16, on the native 10 m UTM grid of each tile (not Web Mercator). Use V7 for current imagery; use this product for historical years.
>
> Explore at [earthindex.ai](https://earthindex.ai) · Produced by [earthgenome.org](https://earthgenome.org) · STAC: <https://stac.earthgenome.org> (V7 collection: `sentinel2-yearly-mosaics-v7`)

# Earth Index yearly imagery mosaics

[![CC-4 license](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-CC--4-blue.svg)](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/)
[![Sensor](https://img.shields.io/badge/Sensor%F0%9F%9B%B0%EF%B8%8F-Sentinel2-blue)](https://www.esa.int/Applications/Observing_the_Earth/Copernicus/Sentinel-2)
[![Format](https://img.shields.io/badge/Format-COG%20%E2%9A%99%EF%B8%8F-purple)](https://www.cogeo.org/)

This repository holds a large (and growing!) collection of cloudless Senitnel 2 data. All bands (except B10 as this was generated from L2A) are available at their original native resolution.

This data is licensed under the creative commons 4.0 international license which, in summary, only requires attribution.

You can read more about how this was created [here](https://medium.com/earthrisemedia/earth-index-imagery-v2-40674f18b4d2).

### Resources
- [Earth Genome STAC](https://stac.earthgenome.org/collections/sentinel2-yearly-mosaics) instance for searching this collection
- [STAC Browser](https://browser.stac.earthgenome.org/collections/sentinel2-yearly-mosaics), human friendly interface

### Naming
Artifacts are name according to their original UTM grid number, concatenated with the start and end dates.  For example the `31TDF_2024-01-01_2025-01-01/` directory will give you bands over for Barcelona (31TDF) over the course of 2024.

### Artifacts and Metadata
All assets are COG encoded GeoTiffs in Web Mercator (EPSG:3857) projection. Besides the item id itself, the STAC catalog has the original UTM infornmation so you can calculate and then reproject to the original EPSG code, if needed.

The STAC assets also have 2 properties to help better understand the provience and quality of the images:

- `good_pxl_pct` is a the estimated percentage of "good" (non masked) pixels
- `generated_from` is an array of references to the Sentinel L2A assets which contributed to this asset
